(2) A transition occurs where a red cylindrical firecracker object appears and bursts into a radiant golden flash of light and sparks. (3) Two women pose outdoors beside a massive, vertical grey rock with orange-red Chinese characters inscribed on it. They raise their arms above their heads to form a heart shape together. One woman is in a beige trench coat, and the other wears a brown coat over a green sweater. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor-outdoor botanical space filled with lush green ferns and hanging red paper lanterns. The two women stand together, smiling and making peace-sign gestures towards the camera. A sparkling, stylized '2025' graphic floats above them as golden confetti falls. (5) A final scene shows a group of about six people gathered around a rectangular wooden dining table in a well-lit modern home. They are all raising wine glasses and tumblers for a toast. Plated dishes and bottles are visible on the table, and the woman from the first scene is present, laughing and participating in the toast.
